Package com.teragrep.nbs_01.repository

Class Notebook

java.lang.Object
com.teragrep.nbs_01.repository.Notebook
All Implemented Interfaces:
ZeppelinFile
public final class Notebook extends Object implements ZeppelinFile
Represents a single Notebook that can be added to a Directory. Is identified by a Path, and corresponds to a file saved on the filesystem.
